collection.title: BMW i3 2013 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a BMW i3 2013 Onwards model which requires a 30" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 21" for the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: BMW i3 2013 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
